purpose: W2-E foundation: add durable DemandRequest/RFQ/OfferVersion/CounterOffer/Negotiation/MatchCandidate authority without mounting a second Deal engine or browser-owned market state.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue the supplied PC-CROP post-registration specification with existing push/PR/merge authorization. Implementation remains blocked until this finite scope is independently accepted and promoted into immutable base-state authority.

excludedAfterSourceAudit.reason: W2-E foundation lives in a dedicated market_negotiation PostgreSQL schema and uses raw SQL through RlsTransactionService. It introduces no public Prisma model; the canonical public datamodel stays unchanged.

The parallel-safe foundation keeps its pure domain module self-contained and tests it by direct source import. Publishing a new barrel export is deferred to the mounted consumer slice to avoid a shared-file collision with W2-D.
The first W2-E slice is a durable authority foundation only, deliberately unmounted so it can be implemented in parallel without overlapping W2-D. HTTP exposure is a later accepted consumer slice.
Canonical Deal creation remains unchanged until W2-C is accepted. W2-E stores immutable accepted market basis facts but does not create or mutate Deal in this first slice.
Existing Auction authority is retained as one origin; W2-E must not weaken or duplicate it.
Search/discovery projection is a later consumer after the market authority exists; it must not become authority in this foundation.
Global CI remains an independent gate and must not be widened or weakened for one bounded market slice.
The generic forward-only checker discovers additive migrations dynamically and remains unchanged.

requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing Auction path and canonical Deal; W2-E adds additional pre-Deal origins only. Do not create DealV2, AuctionV2, LotV2 or a browser-owned parallel marketplace.

DemandRequest, RFQ, OfferVersion, CounterOffer, Negotiation and MatchCandidate are PostgreSQL-authoritative aggregates with tenant isolation, immutable version lineage, optimistic concurrency and payload-bound idempotency.

All W2-E authority tables/functions live in a dedicated market_negotiation schema with ENABLE + FORCE RLS or equivalently confined memberless command ownership; runtime repositories use raw SQL through trusted RLS context, with no public Prisma schema drift.
Commercial terms use exact Money/measure primitives and immutable normalized snapshots; caller Float money, caller-calculated totals or mutable accepted terms are forbidden.
Buyer demand and seller offers are distinct authorities. A seller cannot forge buyer demand, a buyer cannot forge seller inventory, and same-tenant outsiders cannot read private negotiation state.
Each OfferVersion and CounterOffer is append-only. Negotiation acceptance pins exactly one immutable accepted basis version; later edits create new versions and cannot rewrite accepted history.
A MatchCandidate is an explainable projection, never an acceptance or Deal authority. Matching/ranking inputs and policy version are persisted so a decision can be reproduced.

Supply-side offers that represent physical stock reference canonical Inventory identity when known. Lack of independent verification does not manufacture verification and remains compatible with the separately governed Progressive Trust policy.
Demand and offer lifecycle commands revalidate current user, membership, organization and tenant authority before mutation and replay; revocation cannot replay an old receipt as current authority.
Every business mutation commits aggregate state, immutable event, audit and outbox atomically under restricted PostgreSQL principals. Missing audit/outbox/evidence rolls the transaction back.

Accepted market basis is stored as an immutable origin-neutral snapshot suitable for a later canonical DealBasis adapter, but this foundation does not create a Deal or mark a transaction legally committed.

Registration, Role Eligibility, W2-B Auction/Inventory guards, W2-C Deal allocation, W2-D trust authority, Federal Accounting lock #4321, package/lockfiles, external provider claims and production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove buyer DemandRequest/RFQ creation, seller OfferVersion response, counteroffer/version chains, acceptance of one exact version and rejection of stale or changed-payload replay.

Dedicated-schema confinement is proven: no runtime role owns the market tables/functions, PUBLIC cannot mutate them, FORCE RLS/current identity checks apply, and no public Prisma schema drift is introduced.
Cross-tenant callers and same-tenant outsiders cannot read or mutate private RFQ/negotiation rows; revoked membership/user/organization authority fails before mutation and replay.
Concurrent competing accept/counter commands serialize deterministically and cannot accept two different terms for one negotiation version.
Exact Money/quantity invariants reject Float-like or inconsistent totals and retain integer minor units / pinned unit rules.
MatchCandidate stores explainable factors and policy version but cannot by itself create an Offer, acceptance or Deal.
Missing audit/outbox/event evidence rolls back all domain rows and command receipts.
Legacy browser RFQ/offers remain fail-closed boundaries; this first slice does not claim mounted API or user-facing completion.
Forward migrations, zero public-schema drift, backup/restore, cryptographic freshness and exact-head CI/review pass while global independent gates remain unchanged.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Mounted buyer/seller RFQ APIs and role UX remain a later consumer slice after this authority is accepted.
Origin-neutral canonical DealBasis adapter and atomic accepted-offer-to-Deal handoff remain blocked on W2-C Deal inventory allocation.
Search, saved discovery, notifications and market analytics are separate projections and cannot be counted as authority here.
Verified REG.RU runtime and real-user buyer/seller acceptance remain required before terminal MARKET_ENGINE/MULTI_ORIGIN/RFQ/OFFER_NEGOTIATION credit.
